expiresAt.description: Declinable: absent means the server default of 30 days. Always dated once resolved — never null; a link that never expires is the shared password again, wearing a URL.

url.description: Present once, only in the create response — or on GET, only for the owner's own read, and only when CONTACTS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is configured. Only the token's hash is stored otherwise; a lost link is reissued, not recovered.

locale.description: Declinable: falls back to the journal's default.

address.description: Declinable: PostalAddress shape (detailed in the media/postcards area). null clears, absent leaves untouched.

wantsPostcard.description: Refused (invalid_address) if true and the address is not postable.

wantsWhatsapp.description: Refused (invalid_phone) if true and the number is not messageable.

email.description: Changing this on an active row demotes it to pending and clears its grants.

unsubscribe.description: true clears every consent boolean at once.

createdVia.description: `invite:<id>` in practice for the invite case; enumerated values here name the family.

relationship.description: B630, unchanged from v1's owner panel.

pendingTrips.description: Trip ids this contact has asked to join and nobody has opened yet — promoted from the owner page to the API so an agent asking 'who is waiting' gets the same answer a person sees.

tripsOpened.description: The trip ids any pending buddy-link requests just opened by this approval.

channels.description: At least one. Each is checked against this journal's own channel switches and the server's capability before anything sends.

reason.description: Present when attempted is false — e.g. mail_disabled, whatsapp_disabled.

to.description: Masked — last four digits only, never a full number or address.

results.description: One key per requested channel; a channel not requested is simply absent, not reported as skipped.

mail.description: Declinable: absent leaves unchanged. Refused 409 capability_unavailable if the server has no mail plumbing at all.

whatsapp.description: Declinable: absent leaves unchanged. Refused 409 capability_unavailable if the server has no WhatsApp plumbing at all.

voter.description: Browser-generated, from localStorage. Not a person; a reaction from the same device with a cleared localStorage is a new voter.

emoji.description: One of the fixed reaction set (lib/reactions.ts's REACTION_EMOJI).

mine.description: Day slug to this voter's chosen emoji.

PrintPostcardSource.description: trip+day+photo names a published-or-draft entry (owner reads drafts too); photo is a path relative to that trip's media. inbox is a staged-photo id from GET /api/v2/{user}/inbox. Refused (test_content) on a day or trip carrying test: true.

photo.description: Path relative to the trip's media.

PrintPostcardCrop.description: An agent has no way to see the rendered card, so this is realistically never sent by one — kept because it rides the same document the owner's edit door writes into (one field, one write path, no twins).

message.description: What's printed on the back. Own words, from what the author actually told the agent — no composing.

recipients.description: Contact ids. Must all appear in GET /api/v2/{user}/postcards/recipients; an unknown id is refused by name (unknown_recipient). Deduplicated silently — same person twice is one card.

locale.description: One of localesFor(user) (lib/locales.ts). Defaults to the journal's own default locale. Declinable: never inspected, only asserted — the agent states what language the card is written in.

figures.description: Print the trip's traveller figures beside the signature. Absent means on when the trip carries travellers:; only an explicit false turns it off. Same "an agent can't see it, so it won't set it, but the field is shared with the owner's edit door" reasoning as crop.

PrintPostcardOrderPatch.description: Owner-only JSON Merge Patch. Any subset of these fields; refused once the order has left draft status.

recipients.description: Replacement recipient list, filtered against postcardCandidates.

each.description: Frozen at propose time — never re-read from the live price.

providerStatus.description: Stannp's own further word, from the webhook — additive, never contradicts ok.

status.description: Server-owned. expired is computed at read (7-day TTL past expiresAt), not a stored status.

url.description: /{user}/postcards/{id} — where the owner looks and presses Send.

results.description: Present only once sent. No address, ever, in any of these.

text.description: The day's opening line, in this locale.

size.description: One of the instance's offered book sizes.

coverType.description: One of the instance's offered cover types.

includeSwitches.description: Per-section include toggles (e.g. costs, map) offered on the maker page.

dayOverrides.description: Per-day layout overrides, keyed by day slug.

excludedPhotos.description: Photo paths left out of the book.

PrintPhotobookPreviewRequest.description: Owner-browser-only; not part of the agent-facing v2 contract, so this shape follows the maker page's live options rather than a fixed v1 field table.

PrintPhotobookPreview.description: Priced plan from live options. Goes stale (stale_preview) if the trip changes underneath it before the order call spends this quote.

PrintPhotobookPrint.description: Present once the order has been quoted by the provider. Never an address.

files.description: Built PDF file names, downloadable at /{user}/photobooks/{id}/{file} by the owner's own browser.

label.description: The geocoding provider's formatted address string.

credits.description: An amount, never a price — the price is always server-computed from it. MIN_CREDITS–MAX_CREDITS (10–500), step CREDIT_STEP (10).

method.description: PaymentMethod minus admin, which never appears on a purchase this door created.

paymentUrl.description: Absolute; present while pending/requested, null once paid/refunded — there is nothing left to open.

mailedTo.description: The owner's address the purchase-inquiry mail went to.

delta.description: Credits, signed; hundredths precision since B987.

ref.description: What the spend was for — a day slug, a payment id, etc.

note.description: Operator's free text on a grant.

purchasedBytes.description: Bytes added by storage purchases so far.

breakdown.description: One row per trip, inbox, generated output, and other; zero-byte rows dropped. Narrowed to the token's own trip plus an other catch-all for a trip-scoped bearer token.

bytes.description: Bytes cleanup would free (GET) or freed (POST).

message.description: The human sentence v1 already composes.

method.description: Declinable: required and validated only when Stripe is not configured; sending it while Stripe is configured is refused with unsupported_field, since Stripe's own checkout page is where the choice happens.

url.description: The Stripe Checkout URL, Stripe path only.

approver.description: The operator's address the approval mail went to, no-Stripe path only — never the buyer's own, so the response cannot be misread as "you approved this".

creditsAdded.description: Always 0 — literal, so a client cannot infer anything from a nonzero value that will never appear.

creditsGranted.description: The one number this door is allowed to report as landed, because it just did land it.

user.description: Username of the journal to grant credits to.

note.description: Declinable: operator's free text explaining the grant; stored on the ledger row and shown to the owner.

mailedTo.description: The operator's own address — this door mails the approval link to the operator, not the owner.

user.description: Username of the journal whose purchase is being refunded.

note.description: Declinable: operator's free text, included in the owner's refund notice.

shortfall.description: How much of the original grant could not be clawed back because the journal had already spent it — clawBack() floors the balance at zero rather than going negative.

mailedTo.description: The owner's address the refund notice went to.

said.description: What the person actually said this turn.

selected.description: Ids of proposals from a prior turn the person selected before sending this message.

looked.description: Which read tools actually ran this turn — turn-local state the truth-guard checks the model's prose against.

proposals.description: Write proposals this turn drafted, none of them applied yet.

notes.description: Free text, what was actually said. Declinable: the model may not invent notes nobody gave it.

mediaId.description: A staged inbox photo to infer traveller-preset labels from.

presets.description: Suggested traveller preset ids; advisory only, the person picks.

statementId.description: A staged bank export awaiting a column mapping.

mapping.description: Inferred column name to field name (date, amount, merchant, currency).

results.description: Semantic search over a reader-scoped catalogue, filtered to sent (published) days only.

id.description: Opaque identity id; null for a stranger.

admin.description: Whether /admin exists for this address — informational only, every admin route re-checks.

WebDeletionSummary.description: Counted off disk at request time, so the on-screen confirmation sentence is real rather than a description of what is about to happen.

day.description: Slug of the day this photo is attached to, if any.

omitted.description: gps/ is never listed and is not named here — it is omitted unconditionally, not a flag.

next.description: Pagination hint, if the manifest is large.

declineTracked.description: Names of trip-tracked facts (costs, coordinates, ...) this day genuinely has none of. Absent is fine — a day with everything already answered needs nothing here. Written into the day's own declined map before the completeness check runs. Declinable: the day may genuinely lack a fact the trip tracks; naming it here is how that is recorded rather than treated as a missing answer.

sendMail.description: Absent means no letter is sent. The overwhelming safety default: publishing many days must never default to many letters.

sendWhatsapp.description: Same shape and same default as sendMail.

note.description: The human sentence describing what just happened — test-content, visibility and locale aware.

mail.description: Present only if sendMail was requested; the send summary.

whatsapp.description: Present only if sendWhatsapp was requested; the send summary.

notify.description: Present only if nobody was told and a channel exists to tell them on.

ask.description: The nudge to ask the owner, in words, and wait for an answer.

ContentStatement.description: The parsed report of one stored bank_export media item. Read-only, no body accompanies the GET that returns this.

src.description: Echoes the media item this report was parsed from.

trip.description: The trip named at upload, if any.

suggestedCategory.description: A hint from COST_CATEGORIES; never written anywhere until agreed via costs/apply.

merchants.description: One row per merchant, sorted biggest-spend-first.

rates.description: Any currency the statement paid in that the trip's own rates don't already cover.

items.description: category is required per row — the whole point of this call is that a person, not the server, chose it.

statement.description: The src of the statement these rows came from, for the record. Purely informational, not re-validated against the parsed report.

ContentCostCategory.description: One of the closed COST_CATEGORIES list (lib/costFormat.ts). Spell out the actual enum values at generation time from that constant; represented here as a string to avoid a stale hand-copied list.

orphaned.description: Dates in the rows that match no day on this trip.

written.description: False when there was nothing in the GPS store for these dates.

zones.description: Count of private zones cut from the drawn line.

contextCoordinates.description: Nearby points (e.g. the trip's other days) to rank candidates by proximity.

results.description: A ranked shortlist for a person to choose from. Never a single picked answer.

vocabulary.description: What each attribute axis (skin, hair, eyes, hairStyle, outfit, build, age, accessories, cloth) is for and its allowed values.

attributes.description: Resolved plain attributes, never a preset name a caller could pass back elsewhere.

signupToken.description: From the auth agent's own verify step.

username.description: Must match USERNAME_RE and be neither reserved nor tombstoned (isReservedUsername / isDeletedUsername).

visibility.description: The journal's own visibility — only whether this instance advertises the journal, not who may read any given trip.

ContentJournalCreateRequest.description: Deliberately narrower than journalWrite's full shape: a person choosing a username has not yet seen the journal exist, so tagline/figures and every other optional decision are answered later via PATCH /api/v2/{user}, not forced at create time.

reason.description: Present only when available is false.

note.description: A human sentence making clear nothing is deleted yet — a mail with a single-use link is waiting.

counts.description: Mirrors journalStatus.inbox exactly — same numbers, so a caller already holding a /status response can trust this without re-summing.

caption.description: From a .meta.json sidecar, if one exists.

user.name: user
user.description: The journal's username — a directory name, and therefore a security boundary.

trip.name: trip
trip.description: Trip id, unique within the journal, client-chosen forever.

bearerAuth.description: A 7-day agent token (or the helper's 30-minute bridge token). Owner-scope or trip-scope, decided at issue; a route noting 'owner only' refuses trip-scoped tokens with out_of_scope.

cookieAuth.name: fs_session
cookieAuth.description: Browser session (guest or identity cookie). /api/web only; every /api/web door refuses a bearer token outright.
